caseName: Tacoma Grain Co. v. Northern Pacific Railway Co.
caseNameFull: Tacoma Grain Company v. Northern Pacific Railway Company
attorneys: Mr. Charles W. Bunn, for defendant in error, in support of the motion. Mr. John E. Belcher and Mr. Merritt J. Gordon, for plaintiff in error, in opposition to- the motion.

opinions.text:
Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Washington.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Farrell v. O’Brien, 199 U. S. 89, 100; Toop v. Ulysses Land Co., 237 U. S. 580, 583; Piedmont Power & Light Co. v. Graham, 253 U. S. 193, 195.
